uzbek: bir masala haqida uzoq o'ylamoq yoki gapirmoq
usage: To keep thinking or talking about something, especially something unpleasant.
common_mistakes: Keep the particle or preposition in 'dwell on'.
Use this structure: dwell on + noun/wh-clause.
example_sentences: Try not to dwell on one small mistake.
The report dwells on the risks but ignores the benefits.
She refused to dwell on why the plan had failed.
native_notes: Learn the verb and particle as one unit, then practise the full object pattern.

russian: довести обещание или план до конца
usage: To do what you promised or complete an intended action.
common_mistakes: Keep the particle or preposition in 'follow through on'.
Use this structure: follow through on + promise/plan/commitment.
example_sentences: Good leaders follow through on their promises.
The team followed through on every action point.
She needs to follow through on her decision to practise daily.
native_notes: Learn the verb and particle as one unit, then practise the full object pattern.

usage: To use an existing idea, success, or foundation to make further progress.
common_mistakes: Keep the particle or preposition in 'build on'.
Use this structure: build on + noun.
example_sentences: The next lesson builds on what you learned today.
We should build on the success of the pilot project.
Her argument builds on recent research.
native_notes: Learn the verb and particle as one unit, then practise the full object pattern.

usage: To continue to exist or be transferred into another time or situation.
common_mistakes: Keep the particle or preposition in 'carry over'.
Use this structure: carry over / carry + noun + over.
example_sentences: Unused points carry over to the next month.
Stress from work can carry over into family life.
We carried the remaining tasks over to Monday.
native_notes: Learn the verb and particle as one unit, then practise the full object pattern.

usage: To develop or end in a particular way, especially successfully.

usage: To change a failing or difficult situation so that it becomes successful.

usage: To find a practical way to deal with a problem or limitation.

example_sentences: We found a simple way to work around the technical limit.

usage: To decide that someone or something has no chance of success or value.
grammar_pattern: write off + noun/pronoun / write + noun + off
common_mistakes: Keep the particle or preposition in 'write off'.
Use this structure: write off + noun/pronoun / write + noun + off.
example_sentences: Do not write off a learner after one poor result.

collocations: write off + noun/pronoun / write + noun + off
native_notes: Learn the verb and particle as one unit, then practise the full object pattern.
